abi.return_type: NounObject* borrowed candidate pointer or null

execution_order: Save EBX, EBP, ESI, and EDI.
Push the fixed callback words in reverse argument order: 0x018c816a, 0x00b1e500, 0x00b236c0, 0x00d3d420, and 0x00b21080.
Call 0x00b21340 with the hidden ECX receiver and the five stack words; live 0x00b21340 ends with RET 0x14.
Save the returned NounProjectionVector pointer in EDI.
Compute the signed element count as ((vector->end - vector->begin) >> 2), read begin from vector+0x04 and end from vector+0x08.
For each positive-count element, load the candidate object pointer from the 32-bit element array.
Load candidate->vtable and the function pointer at vtable+0x4c, set ECX to the candidate, and call the identity probe with no ordinary stack arguments.
Compare the full EAX identity word with the incoming identity word and return the candidate on the first exact match.
Restore the saved registers and return null after exhaustion with RET 0x4.

UINT32_MAX is not rejected as an invalid identity; a probe returning UINT32_MAX is an exact match.
A negative or zero signed span returns null without probing.
